events.title: Indian Shares Rally On US-Iran Diplomacy Hopes
events.description: Indian shares rallied on Thursday after the U.S. Federal Reserve held interest rates steady, as widely expected, and oil prices eased following fresh diplomatic efforts to end the war in the Middle East.

events.title: CAC 40 Hits 2-week High; Renault Rallies On Strong Earnings
events.description: France's CAC 40 equity benchmark climbed to a two-week high Thursday as investors digested corporate earnings and awaited the European Central Bank's monetary policy announcement. The index advanced 76.14 points or 0.97% to 7,963.10.

events.title: Gold Slips As Investors Seek Clarity On US Rate Outlook
events.description: Gold prices fell toward $4,000 an ounce on Thursday after the U.S. Federal Reserve held interest rates steady, as widely expected, but offered little clarity on its next move.

events.title: Volkswagen Q3 Loss Widens Sharply On Charge, Weak Volume; Confirms FY26 View
events.description: German automotive major Volkswagen AG reported Thursday sharply wider net loss in its third quarter on an impairment charge related to Porsche AG and weak revenues amid lower production and sales volume. Further, the firm maintained its recently lowered fiscal 2026 outlook. On the XETRA in Germany, Volkswagen shares were losing around 1.08 percent

events.title: German DAX Climbs 1.13% Ahead Of ECB Decision
events.description: German stocks extended gains to a fourth consecutive session Thursday, with the DAX rising 289.72 points to 25,993.74 as investors tracked earnings and awaited the European Central Bank's monetary policy announcement and U.S. PCE inflation data.

events.title: Oil Edges Lower On US-Iran Diplomacy Hopes
events.description: Oil prices traded lower on Thursday after surging to a six-month high in the previous session following reports of Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabi's biggest oil refinery and a decline in U.S. crude inventories.

events.title: European Shares Edge Higher Ahead Of ECB Rate Decision, US PCE Data
events.description: European stocks advanced on Thursday after the U.S. Federal Reserve held interest rates steady, as widely expected, despite persistent inflation and dissents from Fed governor Lisa Cook and Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack.

events.title: Asian Shares Mixed As Investors Digest Fed Decision, Tech Earnings
events.description:
Asian stocks ended mixed on Thursday as investors reacted to the U.S. Federal Reserve's rate decision as well as earnings from tech heavyweights, including Alphabet, Microsoft and Samsung Electronics.
 
Ongoing diplomatic efforts between regional Middle Eastern powers to avoid an escalation between the U.S. and Iran helped limit regional losses, if any.

events.title: Canadian Dollar Rises As Crude Oil Prices Advance
events.description: The Canadian dollar strengthened against other major currencies in the Asian session on Thursday, as the crude oil prices surged after reports suggest possible U.S. attacks on Iran by next week, fueling supply disruption concerns for an indefinite period.

events.title: Canadian Dollar Rises Against Majors
events.description: The Canadian dollar strengthened against other major currencies in the Asian session on Thursday.

events.title: European Shares Seen Flat To Higher; ECB Meeting Eyed
events.description: European stocks are seen opening flat to slightly higher on Thursday as investors react to the U.S. Federal Reserve's widely expected decision to hold rates unchanged and await the outcome of an ECB policy meeting later in the day amid France's deepening fiscal woes and political gridlock.

events.title: Indian Shares Modestly Higher As Fed Holds Rates Steady
events.description: Indian shares were modestly higher in early trade on Thursday as the U.S. Federal Reserve left interest rates unchanged, as widely expected, and oil prices eased following fresh diplomatic efforts to end the war in the Middle East.

events.title: Australian Market Maintains Early Gains In Mid-market
events.description: The Australian market is maintaining its early gains in mid-market moves on Thursday, reversing the slight losses in the previous session, following the broadly positive cues from Wall Street overnight. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 is moving well below the 8,850 level, with gains across most sectors led by mining, energy and technology stocks.
